title: Husky tries to work from home
hook: The husky thought working from home would be peaceful.
script: The husky thought working from home would be peaceful.
He set up his laptop on the couch with a cup of coffee.
He opened his calendar and saw a meeting at 10.
He groaned and tried to ignore it.
The meeting started and he turned on his camera.
He blinked at the screen and forgot to smile.
He tried to act professional but kept looking at his tail.
His boss asked, 'Are you okay?'
He nodded and said, 'Yeah, just a little confused.'
He tried to focus on the spreadsheet but kept looking at his phone.
He got an email that said, 'Urgent: Please reply by 3 PM.'
He sighed and typed a reply that said, 'Sure, when?'
He opened another email and saw a deadline for tomorrow.
He stared at the clock and realized it was already 1 PM.
He tried to take a break and flopped onto the couch.
He looked at his laptop and thought, 'This is not working.'
He tried to make a to-do list but kept doodling his face.
He realized he had no idea what he was doing.
He decided to take a walk and got his leash.
He walked outside and saw his neighbor's dog.
He tried to wave but the dog ran away.
He came back and tried to meditate.
He closed his eyes and thought, 'I’m just a dog.'
He opened his eyes and saw his laptop still on.
He looked at the clock and realized it was 4 PM.
He tried to take a deep breath and feel calm.
He looked at his phone and saw a message from his boss.
He read it and thought, 'I’m doomed.'
He closed his laptop and gave up.
He flopped back on the couch and stared at the ceiling.
He thought, 'Maybe working from home is not for me.'
He looked at his coffee and realized it was cold.
He sighed and said, 'I give up.'
He closed his eyes and drifted off to sleep.
The husky had officially lost his mind.
